entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to request activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifier for EPS bearer contexts, used to distinguish between default and dedicated bearers.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifier linking a dedicated EPS bearer to its default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ESM cause #43
entities.description: ESM cause value indicating 'invalid EPS bearer identity'.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Duplicate EPS bearer identity for default bearer
entities.description: Condition where ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST has EPS bearer identity identical to an already activated default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Duplicate EPS bearer identity for dedicated bearer
entities.description: Condition where ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST has EPS bearer identity identical to an already activated dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: No matching default EPS bearer context
entities.description: Condition where linked EPS bearer identity does not match any activated default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: PLMN maximum EPS bearer contexts reached
entities.description: Condition where PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode is reached at the UE.

entities.name: Local deactivation of default EPS bearer context
entities.description: UE behavior to locally deactivate existing default EPS bearer context and associated dedicated bearers when duplicate EPS bearer identity is detected.

entities.name: Local deactivation of dedicated EPS bearer context
entities.description: UE behavior to locally deactivate existing dedicated EPS bearer context when duplicate EPS bearer identity is detected.

entities.name: Send ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: UE behavior to send reject message with ESM cause #43 when no matching default EPS bearer context exists.

entities.name: Clear PLMN maximum EPS bearer contexts determination
entities.description: UE behavior to clear the determination representing PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts and proceed with activation.

relations.description: Duplicate EPS bearer identity for default bearer condition establishes local deactivation of default EPS bearer context.
Duplicate EPS bearer identity for dedicated bearer condition establishes local deactivation of dedicated EPS bearer context.
No matching default EPS bearer context condition establishes sending of ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message.
PLMN maximum EPS bearer contexts reached condition establishes clearing of maximum determination and proceeding with activation.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains linked EPS bearer identity IE.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message contains ESM cause #43 IE.
Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure has step involving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure has step involving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message in abnormal cases.
